verdict.rationale: Clerky documents Delaware C-corp formation with a follow-on legal dashboard for additional paperwork, and online completion and submission of IRS forms. It also supports restricted stock issuance and a customizable equity split at incorporation. These are close to the story but never explicitly cover founder stock purchases, IP assignment, or 83(b) elections. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of founder stock purchase agreements, IP/technology assignment to the company, 83(b) election filing specifically, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these post-incorporation steps.
